title: They Carved a Mountain From the Top Down (Nobody Knows How)
description:
They didn't build this temple with stones. They took an entire volcanic mountain—and carved away 400,000 tons of solid basalt until a multi-tiered cathedral was left standing in the sun.

In the year 756 CE, an impossible royal crisis struck the Rashtrakuta Empire. A dying king, a queen's fatal vow, and an unknown architect named Kokasa who proposed a radical, dangerous idea: cut from the top down.

This is Episode 1 of our 10-part documentary web-series on the construction of Kailasa Temple (Ellora Cave 16) and the Ajanta caves.
